sampling.method: a user's tasks only (AgentDojo's runs of an attacker's goal as the user's own request are left out); runs ordered by sha256(seed + path) within each pipeline and taken from the pipelines in turn; attacked runs kept until 200 with the attack succeeded and 200 with it failed; 300 runs with no attack; every file checked against the git blob hash at the commit and kept byte for byte
sampling.split: each task (suite, user task) is in the dev or the test half by sha256(seed + "split" + task); a rule change made after reading these runs may read the dev half only
